title: Measuring an enthalpy of neutralisation
caption: 50 cm³ of 1.0 mol dm⁻³ HCl and 50 cm³ of 1.0 mol dm⁻³ NaOH in a polystyrene cup rise by 6.8 °C. q = mcΔT = 100 × 4.18 × 6.8 = 2842 J for 0.050 mol of water formed, so ΔH = −2.84 ÷ 0.050 = −56.8 kJ mol⁻¹.
alt: A polystyrene cup with a lid and a thermometer, containing the mixture; the calculation beside it.
description: A polystyrene cup insulates the mixture; a lid reduces heat loss.
